questions.prompt: A call connects but the caller hears silence. Which evidence is most useful?
options: Trace received media, agent output and delivered playback
questions.explanation: Trace both directions and each boundary. Control-plane success can coexist with silent media.

questions.prompt: What should happen before terminating an instance with active calls?
options: Restart immediately because HTTP health is green
Stop admitting work and drain with a defined deadline
questions.explanation: Admission and draining protect existing sessions. Test timeout and replacement behaviour rather than assuming seamless handoff.

questions.prompt: What belongs in a hosting comparison beyond compute rental?
options: Bandwidth, supporting services and operational work
questions.explanation: Compare the same workload scope and include costs needed to run and operate it.
